Microsoft To Do to Ziffr

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address, the Webhook's id and secret, and the id of the To Do list (from Microsoft Graph: `GET /me/todo/lists`).
2. Add the Microsoft To Do credential to the List tasks node.
3. Activate the workflow. Every 5 minutes it tells Ziffr which tasks were ticked or un-ticked, and passes on a line starting "Reply:" in a task's notes.

Self-hosted n8n: set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto. Details: docs/automations/microsoft-todo.md
